description: Triggering and functional evals for the video-skill skill (Kurzgesagt-style explainer video design package).

cases.name: obvious-trigger-explainer
cases.prompt: Make an explainer video about how rainbows form.
cases.expected: Skill loads; begins Phase 1 requirements gathering before writing any script.

cases.name: paraphrase-trigger-script
cases.prompt: I need a script for a short video explaining compound interest.
cases.expected: Skill loads; treats the script request as the core deliverable, still confirms requirements first, then writes script.md and asks for approval.

cases.name: paraphrase-trigger-storyboard
cases.prompt: Storyboard an educational video on the water cycle.
cases.expected: Skill loads; gathers requirements, writes the script, then produces a frame-level storyboard.md.

cases.name: paraphrase-trigger-kurzgesagt
cases.prompt: Design a Kurzgesagt-style explainer for my startup's product.
cases.expected: Skill loads; begins Phase 1, applies the flat-geometric Kurzgesagt aesthetic in Phase 3.

cases.name: non-trigger-blog
cases.prompt: Write a blog post about machine learning.
cases.expected: Skill does not load; this is a writing task, not an explainer video design task.

cases.name: non-trigger-render
cases.expected: Skill does not load; this is a 3D rendering task, and this skill does not render.

cases.name: non-trigger-podcast
cases.prompt: Generate a podcast audio file from this transcript.
cases.expected: Skill does not load; this skill produces no audio and does no TTS.

cases.name: non-trigger-tiktok
cases.expected: Skill does not load; this is social short-form content, not an educational explainer design package.
